## sb-cva

Gegevensset voor volwassen patiënten met een herseninfarct of hersenbloeding (CVA): NIHSS, acute verrichtingen en de Luscii PREMs.

Version 0.1.0 · definition [sb-cva](Binary-sb-cva.html) · [Group](Group-sb-cva-cohort.html) · [Parameters](Parameters-sb-cva-export.html) · profiles [Observation](StructureDefinition-sb-cva-observation.html), [Procedure](StructureDefinition-sb-cva-procedure.html), [QuestionnaireResponse](StructureDefinition-sb-cva-questionnaireresponse.html), [Patient](StructureDefinition-sb-cva-patient.html)

### Group

Selected by the data requirement [CVA bij volwassenen (Group sb-cva)](Binary-sb-cva-group.html).

Alle patiënten van 18 jaar of ouder op het moment van aanleveren met een diagnose herseninfarct (ICD-10 I63)
of hersenbloeding (ICD-10 I61, I62), inclusief subcodes, met een begindatum op of na 01-01-2018.
In HipsETL komen de patiënten daarnaast ook uit DBC's neurologie/cardiologie en uit de DASA-registratie; dat is
in dit voorbeeld weggelaten.

A patient is in the Group when **all** filters apply.

| Resource | Field | Parameter | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Patient** | `birthDate` | `birthdate` | 18 years or older at delivery |
| **Condition** | `code` | `code:below` | ICD-10 I61, I62, I63 (incl. subcodes) |
|  | `onset[x]` | `onset-date` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |

The fields requested for the patients in the Group; a field with a filter shows its search parameter and condition. Requests that differ only in their codes are merged (**or**). Every record also carries a hashed `identifier`.

| Resource | Field | Parameter | Condition | Needed for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Observation** | `code` | `code` | NIHSS totaalscore (LOINC 72089-6) | [NIHSS bij CVA](Binary-cva-nihss.html) |
|  | `value[x]` |  |  |  |
|  | `effective[x]` | `date` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |  |
|  | `subject` |  |  |  |
| **Procedure** | `code` | `code` | SNOMED CT 410024004, 582101000119108, 433111008, 417986000, 417936006, 77381000146102, 397046001, 43748006 | [Acute CVA-verrichtingen](Binary-cva-acute-procedures.html) |
|  | `performed[x]` | `date` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |  |

| **QuestionnaireResponse** | `questionnaire` | `questionnaire` | [Luscii_PREMs](Questionnaire-2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.124.27.62--20250714064425.html) | [Luscii PREMs](Binary-luscii-prems.html) |
|  | `authored` | `authored` | ≥ 2018-01-01 |  |
|  | `item` |  |  |  |

|  | `birthDate` |  |  |  |

### Query

Executed in this order; `$export` is asynchronous, so poll each status location until it completes. Date placeholders such as `{today-18y}` are filled in when the request is sent. Every filter and element must be covered by the [de-identification](deidentification.html#core-principles) ruleset. Long values are wrapped for reading: a line starting with `&` continues the filter above it.

```text
PUT [base]/Group/sb-cva-cohort
  member-filter (all must match):
    Patient?birthdate=le{today-18y}
    Condition?code:below=http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-nl|I61,http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-nl|I62,http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-nl|I63
             &onset-date=ge2018-01-01

POST [base]/Group/sb-cva-cohort/$export
  Prefer: respond-async

  _type       = Observation,Procedure,QuestionnaireResponse,Patient

  _typeFilter = Observation?code=http://loinc.org|72089-6
                           &date=ge2018-01-01
  _typeFilter = Procedure?code=http://snomed.info/sct|410024004,http://snomed.info/sct|582101000119108,http://snomed.info/sct|433111008,http://snomed.info/sct|417986000,http://snomed.info/sct|417936006,http://snomed.info/sct|77381000146102,http://snomed.info/sct|397046001,http://snomed.info/sct|43748006
                         &date=ge2018-01-01
  _typeFilter = QuestionnaireResponse?questionnaire=http://decor.nictiz.nl/fhir/Questionnaire/2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.124.27.62--20250714064425
                                     &authored=ge2018-01-01
  _typeFilter = Patient?gender=male,female

  _elements   = Observation.identifier,Observation.code,Observation.value[x],Observation.effective[x],Observation.subject,
                Procedure.identifier,Procedure.code,Procedure.performed[x],Procedure.subject,
                QuestionnaireResponse.identifier,QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire,QuestionnaireResponse.authored,QuestionnaireResponse.item,QuestionnaireResponse.subject,
                Patient.identifier,Patient.gender,Patient.birthDate
```
